notes.title: Battle of Hořice 1423 just released!
notes.content:
My new game, Battle of Hořice 1423, just released in early access! You can expect new Engine Evolution updates in a week or two! In the meantime, I hope you will enjoy the Battle of Hořice; it is easy to play with simple gameplay, perfect for playing with kids or a girlfriend/boyfriend.

Check it out https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326960/Battle_of_Hoice_1423/

Join the games Discord.

notes.title: Release postponed
notes.content:
Good evening all fans of TRAILDOWN: DOWNHILL MOUNTAIN BIKING! I am sorry to announce that due to complications during the development of "Engine Evolution 2022" and 2023 and my new game "Battle of Hořice," the release of this game must be postponed. The current target date is Q2 2024. I am very sorry for this complication and will try to hit the send target date.

In the meantime, you can play for free: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1871990/Engine_Evolution_2022/

Or wishlist: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326960/Bitva_u_Hoic_1423/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2196640/Engine_Evolution_2023/
Both games will be coming out in Q2 this year.

Petr
